product_one_liner.value: WindBorne combines observations from its long-duration weather balloons with AI models to deliver atmospheric data, forecasts, and actionable weather intelligence for government agencies and weather-sensitive businesses.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage has no pricing link; the pricing URL did not return a public pricing page.

named_customers.notes: NOAA is explicitly described as an operational customer; Air Force and Navy purchases are supported by contracts and awards.

hq_location.notes: Current headquarters; older announcements describe the company as Palo Alto-based.

eng_blog.notes: Technical posts by Electrical Engineering Lead Sarah Brennan and Machine Learning Engineer Haoxing Du describe balloon radio systems and WeatherMesh architecture, respectively.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: A public Machine Learning Research Engineer, Model Evaluation posting and application link are accessible. It is absent from the six-role board index, so the listing and index are inconsistent.

model_provider.value: WindBorne’s proprietary WeatherMesh-6 model; MetaMesh blends WeatherMesh with public AI and numerical weather-prediction models.
model_provider.notes: These are the disclosed forecasting models; the privacy policy mentions third-party AI services without naming their providers.

compliance_certs.notes: The legal/privacy page names none of the five requested certifications; EEA/UK data-protection rights are not presented as certification.

raised_18mo.notes: The August 5, 2026 Series B falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Neither current openings index lists an SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive.

launched_6mo.notes: WeatherMesh-6 was introduced June 1, 2026, within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small published leadership roster was checked in full; its C-level leaders are founders. COO Mei-Lan S. began in August 2025, before the November 9, 2025 cutoff. No qualifying departure announcement was found.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The privacy policy identifies website analytics, product analytics, and event-registration systems. It does not establish use of a dedicated CRM; tools mentioned only as candidate experience requirements were excluded.
